description.en-US: Benson's best-known devotional book (1912), thirteen discourses on friendship with Christ: in the interior soul (the purgative and illuminative ways), in the Eucharist, the Church, the priest, the saint, the sinner, the average man and the sufferer, and in His Passion and Resurrection.
description.pt-BR: O livro devocional mais conhecido de Benson (1912), treze discursos sobre a amizade com Cristo: na alma interior (as vias purgativa e iluminativa), na Eucaristia, na Igreja, no sacerdote, no santo, no pecador, no homem comum e no que sofre, e em Sua Paixão e Ressurreição.

sources.edition: The Friendship of Christ (London: Hutchinson, 1912), Internet Archive full-text OCR (friendshipofchri00bens).
sources.description: Running heads and page numbers are dropped; the OCR was cleaned of line-break hyphens and the commonest recognition slips, and isolated slips remain. Raw text in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: Mgr. Robert Hugh Benson died in 1914 and the edition is of 1912, so the text is public domain.
